text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: high websocket error rate for tenant praesidio-01 via VPC gateway vgw-cc12 (streaming disconnects / 504s). Affected: dedicated pool dp-476. First observed ~2026-03-15T08:45Z. Paging on-call.

oncall-sam: ack — I'm on it. grabbing logs and linking telemetry. @ryan_csm can you confirm customer-side impact?

ryan_csm: praesidio reports live payments dashboard disconnects and repeated reconnects. They started seeing it ~08:45Z, big spike around 09:10Z. Their client added aggressive retries which amplified the issue. They asked for a stop-gap asap.

maria_sre: looking at vgw-cc12 logs — spike in 504 upstream timeouts and websocket close codes. Error rate ~18% on streaming route /v1/stream/payments. Non-streaming endpoints appear fine. Logs show repeated `ws: broken pipe` and `upstream timeout` from the gateway to dp-476.

jordan_reliability: metrics: praesidio QPS -> x3 baseline at spike. dp-476 GPU hosts hitting 92–96% util, request queue depth climbing. KV cache miss rate up ~40%. Seems like a backpressure -> client retry storm -> amplification loop.

lisa_eng: quick mitigations we can do now:
1) Temporarily disable streaming for praesidio tenant (fall back to short-polling)
2) Apply per-tenant connection acceptance throttle at the VPC gateway
3) If needed, fail over traffic to hosted fallback model variant (requires CSM approval re: data policy)
I can execute 1 & 2 immediately.

oncall-sam: do 1 & 2 now. paste commands for ops runbook?

lisa_eng: runbook snippets:
```
# disable streaming for tenant (console internal)
curl -s -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/tenants/praesidio-01/streaming/disable" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"

# apply gateway throttle
curl -s -X POST "https://vpc-gw.internal/v1/tenants/praesidio-01/rate_limit" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"connections_per_sec":5,"burst":10}'
```

oncall-sam: running those now. will report back.

incident-bot: action executed: streaming disabled for praesidio-01 by oncall-sam at 09:18Z; gateway throttle applied.

oncall-sam: applied both. immediate telemetry: connection attempts down ~70%, streaming error rate decreased to ~6%, but dp-476 has backlog — queue depth still elevated and some long-running requests in flight.

maria_sre: started manual scale request for dp-476 — autoscale hit cap. requested burst capacity +2 nodes from Dedicated spare pool (ticket ID: DED-BURST-899). ETA ~8 minutes. Also increased worker aoq/accept window to drain a bit.

jordan_reliability: after throttle + disable streaming we see CPU and queue depth start to fall. latency tail improving. But we should also mitigate retry amplification from gateway/client side — recommend adding `Retry-After` header and close code 1013 (try again later) to force exponential backoff.

lisa_eng: agreed. I'll prepare a small patch to the VPC gateway to send `1013` with a `Retry-After` on aggressive reconnect patterns + enable jittered backoff guidance in headers. We should also increase keepalive/idle timeout between gateway and dp-476 to reduce abrupt closes.

ryan_csm: told customer (praesidio) to reduce retry aggressiveness and accept polling fallback for the next ~30m. They accepted and will roll client-side backoff change.

maria_sre: burst nodes added; dp-476 replica count +2 at 09:27Z. queue drained, CPU to 68% steady. post-mitigation error rate now ~1.2% and user-facing disconnect reports dropped to near zero.

jordan_reliability: recommend follow-up RCA: root cause likely a combination of app gateway keepalive/idle misconfig (causing abrupt TCP closes) plus sudden traffic pattern change from customer leading to retry storm. Secondary factor: autoscale policy bounding burst on Dedicated pool.

oncall-sam: opening incident ticket INC-243210 and postmortem draft. Actions to include in ticket:
- update gateway keepalive and idle timeout config (increase from 30s -> 90s)
- implement per-tenant circuit breaker on connection attempts
- add Retry-After / 1013 behavior for gateway when saturated
- revisit dedicated pool autoscale headroom (increase emergency burst)
- customer guidance: implement exponential backoff + jitter on reconnects
- monitor and add eval prompt-based synthetic streaming test for praesidio traffic profile

lisa_eng: I'll own the gateway config change (PR + rollout with canary), jordan will own autoscale policy change, maria will own the postmortem & monitoring alerts, ryan to coordinate customer follow-up.

oncall-sam: handing off to maria for next 30m. I'm leaving the channel but will remain reachable.

maria_sre: ack — taking over. will update pager & set severity to SEV3.

incident-bot: note: incident severity reduced to SEV3 by maria_sre at 09:36Z. paging temporarily silenced. :thumbsup: 

praesidio-integration: thanks team — our ops lead says the polling fallback is working and they see stability. We'll await the gateway change and follow the backoff guidance. Please keep us posted on the timeline for the config patch.

oncall-sam: closing the immediate mitigation loop. timeline + config PR links will be added to INC-243210. Next steps: schedule 1:1 with praesidio to review final config and follow-up RCA.

jordan_reliability: note to postmortem: include traffic heatmap + per-tenant retry amplification graph. recommend a short-term runbook update to instruct CSMs to request polling fallback for streaming flaps.

maria_sre: will publish postmortem draft in ~24 hours. tagging: praesidio, vpc-gateway, dedicated-pool, streaming, retries.

incident-bot: automated summary posted to #incidents-archive and created ticket INC-243210.
